review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 Overall purpose of the job 职位概述 全面负责公司的城市/园区/楼宇更新改造技术管理工作（建筑/精装），并对各项目设计建设交付进行全流程管控。 Main responsibilities 主要职责 1. 组织领导内部团队及外部设计团队，负责大型片区/园区/楼宇更新改造项目的建筑/室内设计全流程管理，包括前期拓展、方案创意与策略把控、落地与实施管理、与验收交付。 2. 熟练掌握前沿设计理念与改造技术，熟练掌握国际绿建筑标准（如LEED、WELL等）的可持续室内设计策略，具有扎实的动手能力，能够带领团队独立完成具有绿色低碳智能，以运营落地为目标的方案。 3. 对外高度协同建筑、工程、物管、智能化等专业顾问及内部团队，确保室内外设计方案在技术、成本与可持续目标上协调落地，对内制定和审查技术条款，全面管控项目的设计、采购、进度、质量、成本和安全等 4. 对政府及平台公司等客户进行各个阶段的汇报 5. 引*领公司绿色低碳智慧等解决方案先进性 Competencies required 能力要求 1． 具备较高建筑精装设计思路和交付理念，技术上有进取心 2． 有充足能力与意愿对项目交付质量负责； 3． 具备较强的适应性与灵活性，了解甲乙方思维； 4． 有较强的学习能力，有强烈的责任心和团队意识，高度抗压能力； 5． 具备良好的中英文语言表达和沟通能力。 6． 能适应长期出差 Qualification and experience required 资历及经验要求 1． 本科及以上学历，建筑或室内或相关设计专业 2． 8年以上相关设计方案及落地实施经验，其中至少3年以上工程项目综合管理经验 3． 曾参与落地智慧城市或绿色可持续相关项目 4． 有国家注册建造师（建筑专业）一级证书，业绩优秀可适当放宽至二级 5． 有海外项目落地经验者优先

review_candidates.title: 商家运营总监-Director, Existing Seller Growth Team
review_candidates.company: 青岛越洋工程咨询有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 沃尔玛全球电商招聘中，此岗位可base 上海 或者 杭州 Role Overview We are looking for a visionary and results-driven Director to lead the Strategic and Growth Seller Management function within our Existing Seller Growth (ESG) Team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end seller growth strategy for a portfolio of strategic and high-potential sellers, lead and develop a high-performing team of Account Managers, and drive measurable GMV growth at scale. The ideal candidate combines deep cross-border e-commerce expertise with strong leadership presence, a builder's mindset, and the ability to operate strategically while staying close to execution. Seller Profile Strategic sellers with high Walmart commitment and Growth sellers with significant untapped potential — spanning multiple categories and regions. This role oversees both the deep account management of established Walmart partners and the activation and acceleration of high-potential sellers who have yet to fully unlock their platform performance. Key Responsibilities Seller Growth Strategy & Execution: Define and drive the seller growth strategy for Strategic and Growth seller segments. Develop tailored account plans, Joint Business Plans (JBPs), and category-level growth roadmaps. Translate market insights and platform data into clear, executable strategies that accelerate GMV at scale. Team Leadership & Development: Lead, coach, and develop a team of account managers. Set clear performance expectations, foster a high-accountability culture, and build a team capable of managing complex seller relationships and delivering consistent business results. Recruit top talent and build team capabilities for the long term. Seller Relationship Management: Own executive-level relationships with key strategic sellers. Engage sellers to gain deep category and market insights, identify growth opportunities, and remove barriers to platform success. Act as a trusted senior advisor to sellers on Walmart platform strategy, assortment planning, and operational excellence. Cross-functional Influence & Stakeholder Management: Build and sustain strong partnerships across internal teams. Influence stakeholders at all levels to align priorities, mobilize resources, and drive shared outcomes. Represent ESG perspectives confidently in senior leadership forums and cross-divisional discussions. Strategic Business Acumen & Decision Making: Leverage data analytics and financial insights to build compelling business cases, evaluate performance, and make evidence-based decisions. Translate complex data into clear narratives for senior leadership. Anticipate market shifts and proactively adjust strategies to maintain competitive advantage and business momentum. Entrepreneurial Innovation: Monitor market trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging seller models to identify new growth opportunities. Champion a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within the team. Proactively propose and pilot new approaches to seller engagement, activation, and scaling. Operational Excellence & Process Building: Build scalable, repeatable processes for seller portfolio management, performance tracking, and team operations. Establish clear KPIs and reporting cadences to ensure visibility and accountability across the team. Drive continuous improvement in team productivity and operational efficiency. Preferred Qualifications 10+ years of experience in sales, business development, key account management, or seller management within cross-border e-commerce or marketplace environments Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing teams and delivering measurable GMV or revenue growth at scale Deep expertise in cross-border e-commerce marketplace dynamics, seller operations, and category management Strong strategic thinking with the ability to balance high-level vision with hands-on execution and attention to detail Exceptional communication and influencing skills — able to present confidently to and gain buy-in from senior leadership and diverse stakeholders Strong analytical and financial acumen — able to build business cases, interpret complex data, and drive evidence-based decisions Experience building processes and frameworks that scale across teams and geographies Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable with ambiguity, proactive, and motivated by building something meaningful Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Chinese and English Location: Shanghai/Hangzhou Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being welcoming of all people. Walmart doesn’t charge any recruitment or similar fee in the recruitment process, including but not limited to interview, offering, and onboarding.
